name: Ficklefate»
otherNightReminder: Wake the Ficklefate. If they agree, show them the Grimoire for as long as they need. Allow the Ficklefate to make a change to the Grimoire. Put the Ficklefate to sleep. Inform players if their character or alignment changes. The Ficklefate loses their ability – mark them with a NO ABILITY reminder :reminder:
ability: Once per game, at night*, look at the Grimoire & make 1 change. If a Demon is made, deaths tonight are arbitrary. Evil players cannot become good, even if you lose this ability.

jinxes.reason: An Alchemist-Ficklefate has no Ficklefate ability & a Ficklefate is in play. After each execution, a living Alchemist-Ficklefate may publicly guess a living player as the Ficklefate. If correct, the Demon must pick the Ficklefate tonight & the Ficklefate does not wake.
The Cult Leader might turn good due to their ability.
After the Ficklefate uses their ability, the Damsel is poisoned, even if the Ficklefate exits play.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
The Leviathan cannot enter play after day 5.
When the Ficklefate sees the Grimoire, the Demon and Magician's character tokens are removed and cannot be altered.
If the Poppy Grower has their ability, the Ficklefate does not.
If the Summoner creates a second living Demon, deaths tonight are arbitrary.

flavor: Fingers stained blue and blush, conjure rainbows for her brush
